canonical_statement: Let R be a commutative Noetherian ring, I an ideal of R, M a finitely generated R-module, and N a submodule of M. There exists k such that for every n at least k, I^n M intersect N equals I^(n-k) (I^k M intersect N).

canonical_formal_target.planned_signature: forall (R) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] (I : Ideal R) (M) [AddCommGroup M] [Module R M] [Module.Finite R M] (N : Submodule R M), exists k : Nat, forall n : Nat, k <= n -> (I ^ n) * top inf N = (I ^ (n - k)) * ((I ^ k) * top inf N)

domain_and_universes: R : Type u; M : Type v; commutative Noetherian ring R; finitely generated R-module M
hypotheses: N is an R-submodule of M
conclusion: I^n M intersect N = I^(n-k) (I^k M intersect N)

alternate_encodings.target: I^n M intersect N is contained in I^(n-k) N for all n >= k
alternate_encodings.relationship: standard containment consequence, not the canonical equality

alternate_encodings.target: the I-adic filtration induced on N is eventually stable against the filtration of M
alternate_encodings.relationship: filtration formulation expected to be equivalent

degenerate_cases: I = bottom, I = top, N = bottom, N = top, M trivial, and n = k remain within the quantified claim; mutation and simplification checks are deferred.
